claim: `biome.json` turns rules off for paths, matched by glob. A rename moves the files out from under those globs and rewrites no glob, because `rename-page` reads imports and page references and does not read `biome.json` at all. The exemption then covers nothing, every rule it turned off fires on the moved files, and the landing is refused by a count of lint errors that name the code rather than the rename. The rename reads as having broken the code it only moved. Nine globs are keyed to a path today, so the next one to hit this is a matter of which folder moves next.

evidence:
Renaming `temper-lorebooks` to `temper-lorebook` was refused on its first apply with 24 `lint/suspicious/noApproximativeNumericConstant` errors, every one of them in data modules that had been exempted on purpose. `biome.json` held the exemption as three globs opening `temper/lorebooks/modules/`, and the rename had carried those modules to `temper/lorebook/modules/`. Nothing refused the rename for leaving the globs pointing at nothing; the refusal came from the rules the globs had been turning off. The landing went through once a `change-file` on `biome.json` respelled the three globs in the same fold, and is `daf387e7adb956e9755a82d5778419099a764b9b`.

The globs keyed to a path, read at that commit: `design/language/lua-compiler/lualib/**` and `design/language/lua-compiler/lualib-helper/**` turn off six rules; `page/core/**` carries a `noRestrictedImports` option whose message is written for that folder; `temper/lib-treasure/**` and `temper/navigation-addon/**` sit in the same override as the three lorebook globs. `temper/**` and `temper/*-addon/src/**` are keyed to a path too, but to a path no rename of a domain reaches.

What makes it read as broken code rather than as a stale glob: the refusal names the files and the rule, and says nothing of `biome.json`. An agent reading it sees 24 numeric-constant errors in files the rename touched, and the first reading available is that the rename mangled them. The files are byte for byte what they were.

The condition a mend would meet: a change moving a file reads the globs `biome.json` keys to a path as it reads the imports, and either respells a glob the move invalidates or refuses the move by naming that glob.
